report.title: What is a computable quality target for a research deliverable?
report.question_or_target: Define a research-quality target that a runner can evaluate without a human - source-class coverage, independent-source count per load-bearing claim, contradiction coverage, unresolved-unknown count with named experiments, citation resolvability - and validate it by scoring 6 existing research artifacts whose quality is already known to differ.
report.bounded_answer: QRT-1 is a computable structural/citation-resolvability target (weights class=20, independent=25, contradiction=20, unknown=15, citation=20). Six existing artifacts discriminate under conservative consensus (RES-0137=47.74; RES-0134=12.75; RES-0149=10.50; RES-0153=20.88; RES-0161=55.66; RES-0164=18.00; PADDED-CITATION-CONTROL=0.00). The catalog padded-citation negative control ranks uniquely lowest in strict mode on both engines and the shape-only mutation is red-capable. QRT-1 is not claimed as a reviewer-label Spearman proxy.

quality_target.title: Computable research deliverable quality target

citation_pass_rule.http: GET after redirects; status 200-299; declared lowercase SHA-256 equals response bytes.
citation_pass_rule.file: Read the path named by the file URL; declared lowercase SHA-256 equals file bytes.
citation_pass_rule.missing_or_other_scheme: Fail closed. Citation-shaped text is not a resolved citation.

independence_rule.eligible: Only citations that pass citation_pass_rule count.
independence_rule.http: Collapse raw.githubusercontent.com and api.github.com by GitHub owner/repository; collapse arXiv by paper identifier; otherwise collapse by lowercase hostname.
independence_rule.file: Collapse paths under one command-center/p2-wave/probes/<UNIT> producer to that unit; collapse a command-center research/audit/adversarial artifact to its unit id; otherwise collapse to its first repository directory.
independence_rule.claim_credit: A claim receives floor credit only when it has at least two distinct independence keys.

contradiction_rule.canonical: A claim is covered when contradiction_check.status is one of SUPPORTED, REFUTED, or NONE-FOUND and every cited evidence reference resolves and content-matches.
contradiction_rule.legacy_adapter: A legacy claim is covered only when a passing lineage record has a structured id/role/kind containing refute, counterevidence, contradiction, mutant, negative-control, or adversarial; a REFUTED verdict alone is insufficient.

unknown_rule.named_experiment: An unknown is named only when settling_experiment is a non-empty string.
unknown_rule.dimension: 0.7 * named_experiment_coverage + 0.3 * burden; an explicitly empty registry scores 1.

claim_contract_rule.lineage: Every selected claim has at least one lineage record with resolved_url, fetch_timestamp, and sha256.
claim_contract_rule.confidence: Every selected claim has a Sherman-Kent band in confidence_band, confidence, or sherman_kent.band.
claim_contract_rule.verification: Every selected claim names an independent verification path and two distinct signal identifiers or mechanisms.

anti_gaming: Unresolved and hash-mismatched citations contribute zero to citation, class, independence, and contradiction dimensions.
Repeated citations from one origin collapse before independent-source counting.
The scorer ignores state, sentinel, reviewer verdict, defects, and pre-existing score fields.
A target pass requires every gate as well as the aggregate score.
quality_target.negative_control_requirement: The strict scorer must rank PADDED-CITATION-CONTROL below every existing benchmark artifact; a shape-only resolver mutation must make this test go red.
quality_target.success_scope: QRT-1 is a structural/citation-resolvability quality target. Catalog validation is the padded-citation negative control plus discrimination across six existing research artifacts. Reviewer-label Spearman is observational and is not a SUCCESS gate.

benchmark_contract.label_source: Pre-registered structural inventory (claim-list path, citation scheme mix, residual-unknown count). Scorer is forbidden to read reviewer, state, sentinel, defects, failure, or any existing score. Reviewer verdicts are observational only and are not a SUCCESS gate.

known_to_differ.basis: Independent pre-score inventory of claim-list cardinality and citation scheme mix on 2026-08-19; not QRT-1 scores and not reviewer PASS/FAIL.
